items.summary: Disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; counsel_required for any Woot rights-dependent, public-display, affiliate, advertising, or alert-expansion decision. Evidence: Woot documents API access but not redistribution rights, while current terms restrict commercial/public use, storage, derivatives, prices, listings, and data mining. Privacy, consent, vendor, accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep outreach unsent, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work until human counsel reviews the rights packet and all launch gates are complete.

Progress: 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks closed; 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task is closed because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

For complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net, retain parked/private status. No build, publication, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, or spend is legally cleared until dated execution-owner verification, preview/build checks, compliance and security evidence, measurement boundary, rollback point, and an explicit queue-clear or blocker decision are attached by 2026-09-30T17:00:00Z.

Technical compliance is a baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is yellow because source permissions or collector errors exist; this does not independently block ordinary growth. Amazon evidence is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal lift. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when it preserves consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries.
